claim_ceiling: FALSIFIES template-composition explanation within narrow bounded setting only: On 7 tasks (3 product_listing, 3 detail, 1 cart deduplicated from 8 success measurements, 2 checkout errors excluded) from 1 Magento site (docker am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping), truncated-first-20 locatable_sample, 3 definitions — the sample IS NOT informationally zero: structural fields (tag, role, inForm, x, w, h) are identical within each page type (y differs positionally on elements 12-19), and sample-derived metrics achieve perfect task-type discrimination (eta2=1.0 for tag_entropy=2.646 vs2.484 vs2.602, form_fraction 0.85 vs0.95, total_area 341k vs589k vs428k, within-type std0.0), contradicting hypothesis that eta2=0 is mathematical necessity for ANY recipe. Full DOM does discriminate (chi2~463-465 p~5e-52, CramersV~0.15, 501 vs322 vs43 div counts) but so does the sample (MI=1.449 bits=H(page_type) for both). Per frozen decision_rule NOT C1 triggers FALSIFIES: template invariance does not explain parent hierarchy density eta2=0.0; failure is metric-specific (hierarchy mapping collapses between-type variance). Bounded to tested sample/site; no inference to true DOM depth, other sites, full-DOM density values, or per-task sampling necessity. Per-task sampling NOT required for task-type discrimination in this sample; metric design is the bottleneck.
